status: Frozen after inspection of development seeds; not externally registered.
base_changes: No algorithm, simulator, attack, calibration, schedule, or threshold edits. Change only profile metadata, seeds, and navigation evaluation batch size.
primary_family: 30 exact two-sided paired sign tests: 6 games and 24 navigation, jointly Holm-adjusted.

inference.unit: Independent policy-training seed; episodes averaged within seed; domains analyzed separately.
inference.primary_test: Exact two-sided binomial sign test on nonzero paired seed differences. Null: positive/negative signs equiprobable conditional on non-ties. Not a test specifically of the population mean.
inference.ties: Numerically zero differences within 1e-12 absolute are ties; count reported; all ties gives p=1.
inference.effect: Mean paired difference, reported separately from the sign-test hypothesis.
inference.bootstrap: 10000 paired seed resamples, fixed per-contrast RNG; percentile 95% marginal intervals, not simultaneous intervals.
inference.multiplicity: Holm across all 30 primary p-values, including all-tie tests.
inference.exclusions: None based on policy competence, outcome, contact, significance or runtime. Failures are fixed/restarted, not removed.
inference.secondary: All other conditions and timing endpoints retained descriptively, no automatic new confirmatory claims.

review_export: All summaries/episodes and policy weights, all game proposal streams, and the first evaluation-world full trace from EVERY navigation configuration (fixed index 0, not selected by outcome). Full traces retained in server results. Server validates every full trace before export.
